snapshot.title: A'yesha Gaetán Collectives LLC
snapshot.whyThisHotel: Strong qualitative fit for intimate luxury, all-inclusive destination weddings on Grand Anse, with associated guest accommodation and honeymoon stays. A'yesha explicitly positions herself to manage guest room blocks, travel, design, timelines, welcome parties and wedding-weekend details, while the resort delivers its venues, setup and catering. The resort independently advertises weddings accommodating up to 35 guests, beach/garden settings, on-resort planners and custom packages. This supports leisure-celebration account development, not a corporate-meetings or incentive-production forecast. Spice Island must win the individual couple's destination, guest-affordability and style brief against other shortlisted Grenada properties.

snapshot.recommendedNextStep: Develop the intermediary account first: contact A'yesha through the published AGC inbox, reference her firsthand Spice Island review, and ask whether she has an active Grenada couple brief or is building future destination recommendations. Offer a short trade/wedding qualification call and a current resort wedding/group fact sheet, using resort reservations to identify the correct account handler. Clarify her own sourcing role versus host-agency processing and client signature. Only after a live brief exists, request date/category availability and written group/wedding terms, obtain client approval and required agreement/deposit, issue booking instructions, and track pickup through delivery. Create one linked child programme per genuine couple brief; otherwise retain account-development status with no production forecast.
